title: Sales Executive
description:
**Job Title:** Sales Executive  
To generate new business opportunities in the Mangalore region, develop customer relationships, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth handling of customer requirements.

**Location:** Working from Thevara for Mangalore region.

**Salary:** As per company standards (based on experience and performance)

Job Responsibilities

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the Mangalore region.
* Generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
* Conduct client visits, meetings, and presentations to promote company services.
* Follow up on inquiries, quotations, and business proposals.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Coordinate with operations and customer service teams to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and market feedback.
* Monitor competitor activities and market trends.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 1–3 years of sales experience (logistics industry experience will be an added advantage).
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* **Fluency in Kannada, English, and Malayalam is mandatory.**
* Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.
* Valid driving license and willingness to travel within the region.

Key Skills

* Sales & Business Development
* Lead Generation
* Customer Relationship Management
* Negotiation & Closing
* Communication & Presentation Skills

Benefits

* Competitive salary package.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Travel allowance as per company policy.
* Career growth opportunities.

**Interested candidates may send their resume to hr@cochin-logistics.com.**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
